Using given data, I am finding the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain - that is, the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus - regions in human, pig and mouse.

Human
```{r}
total_number_of_genes_human<-sum(180,83,57,110)
print(total_number_of_genes_human)
```
Pig
```{r}
total_number_of_genes_pig<-sum(109,157,31,45)
print(total_number_of_genes_pig)
```
Mouse
```{r}
total_number_of_genes_mouse<-sum(55,185,60,98)
print(total_number_of_genes_mouse)
```
Hence, the human has the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
